intro: The Gripen C (single seat) and D (two seats) are the improved, NATO-compatible version of the Gripen: three larger colour screens with built-in back-up modes, an in-flight refuelling probe and an optional helmet display. The layout of the cockpit, the stick and the throttle is taken as the same as in the A/B, so this guide follows the A/B guide.
